metric_note: relative L2 per test case, mean over the test cases; full grid unmasked or material pixels of the dataset's own mask

specification.name: AEE-FNO
specification.modified_component: Raw output head plus a per-case learned gate that mixes the raw stress with its spectral equilibrium projection, and an Airy-potential correction around the contact

specification.name: RCR-FNO
specification.modified_component: Vanilla FNO of the same seed followed by a fixed removal of 50% of its non-equilibrium component and a trained residual operator (2 layers, width 12, 8 modes) that adds an Airy-potential repair

specification.name: CCP-FNO
specification.modified_component: Output replaced by its projection onto discrete equilibrium plus an Airy-potential correction around the contact
specification.added_loss_or_constraint: hard equilibrium constraint on the output

specification.name: LPM-RCR-FNO
specification.modified_component: LPM-FNO of the same seed followed by the RCR repair, removing 60% of the non-equilibrium component

specification.name: MICE-LPM
specification.modified_component: LPM-FNO of the same seed followed at inference by the smallest equilibrium projection, in a metric weighting contact and hotspot regions, that meets a residual budget of 100

specification.name: LPM-FNO
specification.modified_component: Feature-wise gain and bias in every layer from the spatial means of the condition channels

specification.name: DCT-FNO
specification.modified_component: Fourier transform of the spectral layers replaced by a cosine transform (width 32, 16 modes; compared with the FNO of the same width and modes)

specification.name: CCM-FNO
specification.modified_component: Untruncated convolutional branch (width 16) on a 16 × 16 window around the contact point, Gaussian-gated, plus two contact-relative coordinate channels

specification.name: HGM-FNO
specification.modified_component: As CCM-FNO (branch width 24), with the window centered at the soft-argmax of the predicted stress magnitude

specification.name: DWM-FNO
specification.modified_component: Both windows of CCM-FNO and HGM-FNO (branch width 8)

specification.name: DeepONet
specification.modified_component: Convolutional branch and coordinate trunk, width 32, basis 32
